description: sheleg-dev — the manual gate. A PreToolUse hook that refuses money movement, an irreversible action, live production access and the pack's own free-money path unless the authorised person has signed the category off for this session. Deliberately carries NO `if` filter: the reference calls that filter best-effort and says it fails open on a command it cannot parse, so the decision is made in lib/moneygate.js instead. Exits 0 on every path, so a project that never touches payments sees nothing.
